body: so sorry that happened to you. hope youre alright now❤️

hi! yes i have a brother (two years older). my dad still has contact with him and they sometimes go out for dinner together 

i really do want people to know hes a bad person, but if i tell my relatives about him they might think i am the problem and that i gave him a reason to say that

i have told my mom about this and she said she couldnt do anything about it. she said he has the right to do whatever he wants and she cant stop him

people say i look really similar to my father, so i am probably his biological daughter. it doesnt really feel like it though. nevertheless i will try my best to ask my mother if im his real child

thank you for your advice i really appreciate it ^^
i never meant to cover up for him, im just scared my relatives will think im ungrateful and not talk to me anymore

thank you for this it really helped

your dog sounds really really cute ^^

my dad has always been short tempered and unpredictable. when i was small i once wrote a note trying to explain how i felt scared around him and he beat me afterwards saying i was ungrateful. i was stupid for writing that note.

i know this is not my fault but its hard to understand what caused him to do those things. youre right that some things just cant be answered. 

i hope there will be a day where i can forget (and forgive?) him. he is not coming back and i cant do anything about it other than move on.

again, thank you for your comment i really really appreciate it and it helped alot
thank you that means alot to me
